title: Random Item Rush
description: Random Item Rush is a game where every five minutes you are assigned a random item that you must search for and gather before the timer runs out. If you fail, you lose a life, and once you run out of lives, you are out of the game.
body:
Random Item Rush is a fun minigame you can play solo or with your friends.

At the start of each round, you are assigned a block that you must collect in your inventory before the timer runs out. If you fail to collect your block in time, you lose a life.

Don’t worry! If you get a block you don’t think you can gather in time, you can reroll your target using the /reroll command.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------

How to Start

1. Configure your settings using the /rushConfig command (see the commands section below).
   
2. Run /rushReset to reset lives, rerolls, and assign a new target block.
 
3. Run /rushStart to begin the game.
 
4. Start collecting your assigned block!

--------------------------------------------------------------------------

Commands
- /reroll – Rerolls your current target block.
- /rushStart – Starts or resumes the timer.
- /rushPause – Pauses the timer.
- /rushReset – Resets the timer, lives, and rerolls, and assigns a new target block.
- /rushStartTime <Integer> <s/m/h> – Sets the length of the timer per round. Use a whole number followed by s (seconds), m (minutes), or h (hours).
- /rushConfig <lives/rerolls/rarity> <value> [true/false] – Configure game settings:
    - lives → set number of lives
    - rerolls → set number of rerolls
    - rarity → set allowed rarity (common, uncommon, rare, epic) and optionally enable/disable it with       true/false

Thank you for playing my mod!
